commands:
mkdir -p .prflow/tmp
rm -f .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-disabled 2>/dev/null &&
git status --porcelain -z > .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before &&
[ -f .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before ] &&
[ ! -L .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before ] &&
git hash-object .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before

echo "=== workflows: no job-wide publication (expect 0 each) ==="; for wf in devflow-implement devflow; do printf '%s: ' "$wf"; git show 77dc3aeabe35a9cc834d17fb8e142128192d7d30:.github/workflows/$wf.yml | grep -vE '^[[:space:]]*#' | grep -cF 'echo "DEVFLOW_REFRESH_SELFTEST_FAILED='; done
echo "=== workflows: Stop step self-derives export (expect 1 each) ==="; for wf in devflow-implement devflow; do printf '%s: ' "$wf"; git show 77dc3aeabe35a9cc834d17fb8e142128192d7d30:.github/workflows/$wf.yml  …[per-command-truncated]

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
